summary: Candidate is a distinct Flink DataStream iterate() pattern for feedback loops in stream processing. It differs semantically and operationally from existing skills: not related to Python concurrent.futures (Executor/wait patterns) or Flink environment/source setup. The iterate() method implements a specific feedback-loop control flow unique to Flink's DataStream API. No existing skill covers this capability, and peer candidates are complementary setup/initialization skills, not overlapping feedback-loop implementations.
